country.attribution: Country boundaries from Natural Earth (public domain).

climate.attribution: Koppen-Geiger climate classification from Beck et al. (2023), Scientific Data 10, 724, doi:10.1038/s41597-023-02549-6 (CC BY 4.0).
climate.note: Climate zone classified from the Köppen–Geiger class at this location (Beck et al. 2023, 1991–2020), mapped to the tool's zones by the methodology's documented table.
climate.resolution_caveat: The bundled classification grid is 0.1 degrees, roughly 11 km. It is reliable for the city a site sits in and is not a statement about the site itself — which is the resolution at which climate zone enters this methodology in any case, since it selects a row of an adjustment matrix rather than a temperature.
